poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Debuff duration. Take 10 damage at the start of each tick after Instant spells, then lose 1 duration. New applications add duration.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Buff duration. Heal 10 at the start of each tick after Instant spells, then lose 1 duration. New applications add duration.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: Absorbs direct damage before Health; excess damage hits Health. Damage over time bypasses Ward. Does not stack: gaining Ward keeps the higher of your current Ward and the new amount. Does not decay.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Cancels the current enemy spell, even a 1T spell finishing this tick. Also skips the remaining copies in its current Channel group (up to 3). Simultaneous interrupts cancel each other.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.description: 50% more direct damage, direct healing and Ward. Does not increase counters, durations, Trigger payloads or percentage effects.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Completing a Fire spell grants 1 Heat. At 3 Heat, your next non-Instant Fire spell consumes 3, becomes 1T and Empowered. Slow then adds 1T if present.

oath.name: Oath
oath.description: Only one Oath at a time. Evaluate the following completed spell or spells. Succeed to resolve the printed reward immediately; a new Oath replaces the old one.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Each charge is consumed when a non-Instant spell starts, adding 1T.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove the printed number of debuff types: Poison, Slow, Trap or Curse.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Resolve a spell’s effects again without advancing the sequence. A repeat does not count as another spell for Oaths or augment counters.

consume.name: Consume
consume.description: Remove the named duration or charges and use the amount removed for the payoff.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Link up to 3 matching spells in adjacent slots. Each extra copy adds the Channel bonus to every spell in the group. Interrupt cancels the remaining group.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Only one copy may be held. Matching shop copies can still upgrade it.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: One pass through the active sequence, followed by one reshuffle tick.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Debuff counter. Take 10 damage per stack when your next cycle begins, after reshuffling. Stacks persist until cleansed.

attunement.name: Attunement
attunement.description: Your two most numerous domains are attuned. Ties favor the oldest card still held. Only effects explicitly marked with a domain attunement requirement need that domain; unmarked effects remain usable.

instant.name: Instant
instant.description: Resolves before other effects that tick, including over-time effects and ordinary spells. Simultaneous Instant spells resolve together.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: After completing a spell, consume one charge and take 10 damage. Echo is not a second cast.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Each charge prevents one incoming damage event and is consumed. Explicit Health costs bypass Guard.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Repeat the spell effects at the stated effectiveness, rounding down. Does not count as a cast or produce another Echo.

critical.name: Critical
critical.description: Deals 150% direct damage by default. Determined by printed spell conditions, not random chance.

cultivate.name: Cultivate
cultivate.description: Consume the named duration or counter and immediately resolve the printed payoff.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Put the named effect on the enemy. Applying Regeneration heals the enemy.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Put the named effect on yourself.

summon.name: Summon
summon.description: At the end of the tick, summon or revive an Imp with the printed Health. If still alive, add to its current and maximum Health. It absorbs direct enemy damage; overflow hits you. Applied effects and damage over time still hit you. Empowered Imp attacks after each spell you complete.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.description: After a successful cast and its Echo, this copy breaks for the rest of the duel. Remaining cards move together. Returns next duel.

unholy.name: Unholy
unholy.description: Your healing becomes damage to the enemy for the duration, including Regeneration. Printed healing converts even at full Health; heal-to-full converts only missing Health. Enemy healing stays unchanged.

tide.name: Tide
tide.description: Completing a Water spell grants 1 Tide. At 3 Tide, your next non-Instant spell consumes 3 and Echoes at 50% effectiveness.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Dormant until this copy completes its first cast and its entire effect chain. Once Armed, resolves at most once per tick, in sequence order. Normal Trigger effects can activate other Armed Triggers. Broken cards lose their Trigger.

retrigger.name: Retrigger
retrigger.description: Repeat the last eligible Armed Trigger resolved this Cycle, ignoring its per-tick limit. Does not update Trigger history, retrigger Retrigger, or activate other Triggers.

awaken.name: Awaken
awaken.description: When the printed condition is met, this copy transforms for the rest of combat. Happens once per copy.
